limitations: Only the four assigned new original candidates and four exact original references were opened. The comparison used native 618x824 candidates and declared 1236x1648 references at factor two; no resizing, crops, contact sheets or additional images were created or substituted.

The source/binary/reference/plan/tool tuple and immutable inventory hashes are owner declarations. The final full manifest is pending; this report is a bounded batch record, not full-round acceptance.

All four current cases have menu=true. Visible header, bookmark, progress and navigation chrome is open-reader UI; these PNGs do not independently qualify closed-reader artwork-only rendering or source-art provenance.
Artwork patterns and framing differ from the sample. UI hierarchy, text legibility, dividers and control bounds were assessed directly without waiving those checks because content differs.

Static appearance and existing owner action/state records are separate evidence. No mechanical PASS was substituted for actual image viewing, and no saved/render/effective preference difference was treated alone as a behavior defect.

Screenshots and this static assignment do not qualify hidden hit regions, physical input, native framebuffer/evdev rotation, physical 270-degree rotation, sleep/wake, e-ink or illumination effects, performance or a genuine live-reader lease.
Exact font identity, pixel metrics and contrast ratios were not computed; the assigned original images were readable enough for the stated bounded observations.
